title: Rainier Sunrise to Seattle, Road Trip's End
summary: Sunrise at Rainier, then west to Seattle to return the car, say goodbye, and settle into Belltown.

segments.name: Segment 1 — Rainier sunrise, Reflection Lakes
segments.blurb: Early light on the mountain before the long drive out.

map.center: Reflection Lakes, Mount Rainier National Park

stops.name: Reflection Lakes
stops.note: Same pull-off as last night, best light at dawn.

stops.name: Henry M. Jackson Visitor Center
stops.q: Henry M Jackson Visitor Center Paradise
stops.note: Coffee and restrooms before the drive down.

stops.name: Narada Falls
stops.note: Quick stop on the way down toward Longmire.

segments.name: Segment 2 — Drive to Seattle via Longmire
segments.blurb: Down through the park's original headquarters and the small gateway towns.

stops.name: Longmire
stops.note: Historic park headquarters and the National Park Inn.

stops.name: Ashford
stops.note: Small gateway town just outside the Nisqually entrance.

stops.name: Eatonville
stops.note: Town along SR-7 on the way north to I-5.

segments.name: Segment 3 — SEA airport, car return and goodbye
segments.blurb: Rental car back at Sea-Tac; Kuek and Kim fly home at 7:50pm.

stops.name: Seattle-Tacoma International Airport
stops.note: Rental car return, then Kuek and Kim head to their 7:50pm flight.

stops.name: SEA Rental Car Facility
stops.note: Consolidated rental car return center, connected by shuttle.

stops.name: Link Light Rail, Airport Station
stops.q: Sea-Tac Airport Link light rail station
stops.note: Train option into downtown Seattle after the return.

segments.name: Segment 4 — First evening in Belltown
segments.blurb: Just Jason and Alicia now; Pike Place is an 8–10 minute walk.

stops.name: Belltown
stops.note: Dense residential neighborhood just north of downtown.

stops.name: Pike Place Market
stops.note: 8–10 minute walk south along 1st or Western Ave.

stops.name: Olympic Sculpture Park
stops.note: Waterfront park a short walk west, open until dusk.
